title: Integrate reviewed corrections with the conormal and cyclic relation towers
body:
## Current-main integration — new Lean checks PASSED

**Verified head:** `2abc351424ba87aeda948a5cfb846e15ed9373d1`.

**[Successful push run 34717443909 / job 103617105475](https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/zeta-function-research-reader/actions/runs/34717443909/job/103617105475).** The completed job and full log were read back. Every step succeeded, including both new source checks, the combined import, and the complete selected-axiom audit sequence.

This review branch includes current main at `4c5ce7a8575fa8b95df272116eb5783b2309cdb7`, incorporating the concurrent Codex publication into this branch only. The final compare against that main snapshot is **eight added files, 855 additions, no modified or deleted existing files, and zero commits behind**. No inherited mathematical source, original scalar, quotient implementation, dependency pin, existing workflow, or other-session branch is changed. Main is not merged or otherwise modified by this contribution; this remains a draft PR.

## Genuine GitHub corrections incorporated

**Mathematical scope:** `600ab7a527f7a626c162bf0199d093d454b86c14` restricts the monic-freeness argument to nonempty packets and calculates h=1 separately. The new `top_level_zero` theorem handles the full relation ideal at every power, rather than applying a positive-degree basis formula to the empty packet. The finite arithmetic quotient is zero in that branch; the analytic theta seed and its mass, the global Q, and the original e/tau distinction are not erased.

**Validation provenance:** `7aec03a93b66d3d97fbf6f7042f58bb2c1019543` gives the completed Codex audit as **68 selected declarations**, not the historical 66, and retains the corrected successful-run provenance and ongoing main-branch frontier workflow. The added workflow reruns this actual 68-target audit.

**Concurrent publication:** the later main snapshot `4c5ce7a...` and its new reader routes, frozen editions, and metadata are preserved unchanged. Preserving those files is not a claim to have independently audited the entire reader collection.

## Completed formalizations

### `SplitZeroConormalTower.lean`

Over an arbitrary commutative coefficient ring and algebra, prove `D(I^(r+1)) <= I^r` directly from the derivation law and ideal-product induction. Use the **merged Codex `SplitZero.RelationLayer.derivative` interface** to construct the consecutive original quotient maps, their representative formulas, and their commuting square with quotient transitions. No squarefree or derivative-stable-ideal hypothesis is imposed.

Construct the exact cyclic relation at depth r as the pullback of I^r along polynomial evaluation at S. Prove that the resulting quotient evaluation is injective. When D(S)=1, construct formal differentiation between the cyclic quotient levels and prove its square with the ambient quotient derivative. This uses the actual pullback at every depth, not the r-th power of the first cyclic relation.

Retain the full multiplier identity `delta([u P(S)]) = [u P'(S)] + [D(u) P(S)]`. The second term remains in the ambient target; it is not presumed cyclic. The conormal response `[z a] -> [a D(z)]` and the empty-packet/full-ideal case are also proved.

These are bundled coefficient-linear maps on the original quotient types. A further bundled algebra-map or supported-map instantiation is not counted as a new theorem merely because the existing library provides a way to construct it.

### `SplitZeroCyclicDepth.lean`

Prove equivalence of the quotient/remainder predicate with the literal condition `sum_i floor(a_i/m_i) < r`. For positive multiplicities and positive depth, prove the exact maximum total degree

`sum_i(m_i-1) + (r-1) max_i m_i`,

and construct a monomial attaining it by placing all extra quotient degree at a maximal-multiplicity coordinate. Both the bound and attainment are checked for arbitrary finite index sets. The local order's increment with relation depth is also proved.

The polynomial quotient-basis identification, the characteristic-zero multinomial nonvanishing step, and the CRT/annihilator interpretation are **complete written proofs in the note**, not additional Lean declarations in this certificate.

## Written cyclic calculation and retained distinctions

For a root tuple with multiplicities m_i, the exact local nilpotency order is `1+sum_i(m_i-1)+(r-1)max_i m_i`. Taking the maximum over every tuple with the same sum gives the exponent of chi_r. Thus `I^r intersect C[S]=(chi_r(S))`. The note proves the quotient and derivative divisibilities and explains why chi_r must not be replaced by chi_1^r.

The finite checker includes a collision where the maximizing tuple changes with depth: roots 0,1,2 with multiplicities 5,4,1, tensor degree two, sum 2, give exponent `max(5r,4r+3)`. It also checks h=(s-rho)^2 in degree two, where chi_r has order 2r+1 rather than 3r. These are declared algebraic calibrations, not arithmetic zero claims.

The note verifies the handoff's explicit S-equivariant cyclic retraction, including the inverse of the polynomial pi0(w), and retains the invariant complement, full action, and Gram cross terms. This retraction is a written result, not part of the new Lean scope. The cyclic trace is not identified with the full symmetric trace, and the arithmetic Taylor unit is never assigned one.

## Fresh validation record

Unchanged **Lean 4.31.0** and Mathlib **`fabf563a7c95a166b8d7b6efca11c8b4dc9d911f`**. The original 7,366-byte SplitZero core was verified. The inherited library and Codex/frontier modules rebuilt, and the two new files passed separate `--trust=0 -DwarningAsError=true` checks.

All **29 selected new declarations' transitive axiom reports** passed, using only subsets of `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`. The combined import passed. The prior **frontier40, Codex68, boundary38, tau87, derived73, and structural28** audits passed again. Counts include definitions and infrastructure, not discoveries.

Final source SHA-256 values printed by the successful run:

```
0817bccbc362699b54b3cb3f6e1ea6bcc417ac9cabd35df3285af940ea6d5580  SplitZeroConormalTower.lean
97764365d88970910ecd6f12cd3d5f1fbf268a7c8939f34d529ed6c97b424463  SplitZeroCyclicDepth.lean
```

The new **eight-method exact finite-model suite** passed normally and under `python -O`, with identical successful JSON records. Deliberately failing controls failed in both modes. Twenty-five inherited harness/regression tests also passed in both modes. These finite tests do not replace the Lean proof or the written polynomial arguments. Earlier development failures remain in the branch history; notation, elaboration, normalization and linter issues were repaired without weakening conclusions or disabling checks.

## Source reading and remaining interfaces

The uploaded 28-line cyclic handoff was read in full. The local execution service failed before the associated cyclic ZIP could be opened. Therefore this is **not** an independent manifest audit or rerun of that package's reported 24-method checker, nor a verification of its analytic moments or uniform tensor estimate. The formal work follows the handoff's explicit finite targets and inspected GitHub interfaces.

The precise source-to-Lean boundary and full written proofs are in `workbenches/tau-conormal-cyclic-formal/RESEARCH_NOTE.md`; the independent finite tests are in `check_depth_models.py`. The analytic cyclic convolution metric, its differentiated moments, the full source-to-trace instantiations, and the uniform arithmetic control estimate remain separate. No private transcript or external literature corpus is published; no Sneed submission or main merge is performed.
